screen.worldarchive.create.title: Create Backup
screen.worldarchive.create.explanation: Add a label if you like. Large worlds can take a while, so keep Minecraft open until it finishes.
screen.worldarchive.cleanup.choose: Choose which backups to delete from this computer. Copies on your Git remote are kept and stay listed; use Delete to remove one from the remote.
screen.worldarchive.delete.labeled: %s of them have a label. Labels protect backups from cleanup, not from Delete.
screen.worldarchive.delete.prompt_many: Delete these %s backups from every destination? You cannot undo this.
screen.worldarchive.delete.prompt_one: Delete this backup from every destination? You cannot undo this.
screen.worldarchive.delete.remote_many: %s of them have a copy on your Git remote. Those copies are deleted too.
screen.worldarchive.delete.remote_one: Its copy on your Git remote is deleted too.
screen.worldarchive.import.title: Import Backups
screen.worldarchive.import.choose_source: Choose where your backups are stored.
screen.worldarchive.import.from_folder: From a folder of ZIP backups
screen.worldarchive.import.picker_title: Choose a folder of WorldArchive backups
screen.worldarchive.import.picker_waitin: Choose the folder that holds your backups...
screen.worldarchive.import.picker_failed: The folder picker did not open. Try again.
screen.worldarchive.import.checking: Checking which backups can be imported...
screen.worldarchive.import.looking_store: Looking for backups WorldArchive already stores...
screen.worldarchive.import.read_failed: Could not read those backups, so nothing changed: %s
screen.worldarchive.import.stopped: Import stopped: %s. Some backups may already be imported, so go Back and check before you try again.
screen.worldarchive.operation.world_chan: The world changed while it was copied. Wait a moment, then choose Retry.

screen.worldarchive.restore.title: Restore Backup
screen.worldarchive.restore.explanation: This creates a new world from the backup. The original world is not changed.
screen.worldarchive.restore.returns_to_l: Restore shows the new world in the world list
screen.worldarchive.restore.prompt: Restore %s as a new world named "%s"? If that name is taken, the next free one is used.
screen.worldarchive.restore.name_blank: Enter a name for the new world
screen.worldarchive.restore.name_ends_wi: The name cannot end with a dot or a space
screen.worldarchive.restore.name_unsafe: The name has a character that folder names cannot use
screen.worldarchive.restore.name_same: That is the original world's folder. Choose another name.
screen.worldarchive.storage.title: Storage · %s
screen.worldarchive.storage.loading: Checking how much space backups use...
screen.worldarchive.storage.breakdown_to: Counts backup files on this computer. Git snapshots share data, so cleanup can free less space than shown.

screen.worldarchive.storage.forecast.lea: Learning how fast backups grow. The forecast needs 7 days of data.
screen.worldarchive.storage.forecast.one: About 1 day until backups reach the limit
screen.worldarchive.storage.forecast.day: About %s days until backups reach the limit
screen.worldarchive.storage.keep_help: How many daily, weekly, and monthly backups to keep. Cleanup never deletes labeled backups.
screen.worldarchive.storage.invalid: Enter a number for the limit, and whole numbers for daily, weekly, and monthly
screen.worldarchive.storage.near_limit: Backups are near the limit. Review Cleanup to free space.
screen.worldarchive.storage.no_limit: Set and save a storage limit first
screen.worldarchive.storage.not_counted: copies on your Git remote or in linked folders are not counted
screen.worldarchive.storage.save_first: Save first. Cleanup uses the saved limit.
screen.worldarchive.select_world.mismatc: The selected world changed. Select it again.
screen.worldarchive.edit_world.no_world: Open Edit World from the world list to use WorldArchive backups
screen.worldarchive.operation.cancelled_: Partial files are being removed. A destination that already finished keeps its copy.
screen.worldarchive.settings.defaults_re: Defaults restored. Choose Save to apply them.
screen.worldarchive.settings.folder_pick: The folder picker did not open. Type the full path instead.
screen.worldarchive.settings.git_enabled: Enable Git and Git LFS backups
screen.worldarchive.settings.health_chec: Checking Git, Git LFS, and destination folders...
screen.worldarchive.settings.no_worlds: No worlds were found in the saves folder.
screen.worldarchive.settings.notice.copy: %s is a copy of %s, so it now has its own backup history
screen.worldarchive.settings.notice.repl: %s has a new WorldArchive identity, so its old settings were not kept
screen.worldarchive.settings.notice.shar: %s share one WorldArchive identity. Open the world that should keep the backup history first
screen.worldarchive.settings.notice.unre: %s is left out: its WorldArchive identity could not be read (%s)
screen.worldarchive.settings.path_hint: Full folder path on this computer
screen.worldarchive.settings.remote_name: The Git remote name (usually origin). Set each world's repository URL on the Worlds tab.
screen.worldarchive.settings.reset_done: Settings were reset. The old file was kept as %s
screen.worldarchive.settings.reset_not_n: The settings file can be read again, so nothing was reset.
screen.worldarchive.settings.schedule_in: Minutes between automatic backups (applies to Git and ZIP)
screen.worldarchive.settings.title: WorldArchive Settings
screen.worldarchive.settings.unreadable_: Backups are paused, and %s is not overwritten until it can be read. Fix the file and open this screen again, or choose Reset settings to start over from the defaults. The old file is kept.
Settings could not be read: a newer WorldArchive saved them. Update WorldArchive, or reset the settings.
Settings could not be read: they come from WorldArchive 0.1.0, which this version cannot read. Reset the settings, then use Import on the old Git repository to bring back its backups.
screen.worldarchive.settings.validation_: Some settings are not valid. Check the folder paths.
screen.worldarchive.settings.world_remot: Paste the address of this world's Git repository. Each new backup uploads to it. If an upload fails, choose Sync on that backup to try again.
screen.worldarchive.settings.world_zip_t: A folder for this world's ZIP backups only. Leave it off to use the folder from the ZIP tab.
screen.worldarchive.worlds.empty: No worlds yet. Play a world once, or use Import to bring in old backups.
screen.worldarchive.worlds.archived_tool: The original world is gone. You can still restore and delete its backups.
screen.worldarchive.worlds.review_toolti: The backups of this world are near or over its storage limit.
screen.worldarchive.worlds.title: World Backups
screen.worldarchive.browser.create_world: Backups are off for this world. Turn them on in Settings, on the Worlds tab.
screen.worldarchive.browser.create_no_de: No destination takes manual backups. Turn one on in Settings.
screen.worldarchive.browser.create_git_m: Only Git takes manual backups, and Git or Git LFS is missing. Install both, or turn on ZIP backups.
screen.worldarchive.browser.create_stora: A backup folder is inside a world, so backups are paused. Choose another folder in Settings.
screen.worldarchive.cleanup.nothing: Nothing to clean up. Your keep settings protect every backup.
screen.worldarchive.cleanup.select_more: still over the limit, select more
screen.worldarchive.cleanup.rest_protect: still over the limit, the rest is protected
screen.worldarchive.cleanup.confirm_warn: These backups are deleted from this computer. You cannot undo this.
screen.worldarchive.cleanup.reviewed: I checked every backup on this list
screen.worldarchive.cleanup.last_copy: This is the last copy. You cannot restore this backup after cleanup.
screen.worldarchive.cleanup.other_copy: Another copy of this backup is kept.
screen.worldarchive.operation.restore_ca: The partial world copy was removed. No world was changed.
screen.worldarchive.runtime.settings_unr: WorldArchive settings could not be read (%s), so backups are paused. Open Settings to fix or reset them.
screen.worldarchive.runtime.loading: WorldArchive is still loading. Try again in a moment.
screen.worldarchive.runtime.world_unavai: The world folder is not available for a new backup. Open the world list again.
screen.worldarchive.runtime.busy: A backup of this world is already running. Try again when it finishes.
screen.worldarchive.runtime.world_loadin: This world is still loading. Try again in a moment.
screen.worldarchive.runtime.world_not_sa: The settings could not record this world's folder. Open WorldArchive settings to check them.
screen.worldarchive.runtime.quit_wait: WorldArchive is finishing a backup. Minecraft closes as soon as it is done.
screen.worldarchive.notice.exit_started: Creating backup... Keep Minecraft open until it finishes.
screen.worldarchive.notice.exit_done: Backup finished. You can safely quit Minecraft.
screen.worldarchive.notice.exit_warnings: Backup made, but a destination had a problem. Open Backups to see which.
screen.worldarchive.notice.exit_failed: Backup failed. Your world was saved. Open Backups to see why.
screen.worldarchive.notice.exit_skipped: Backup skipped. Your world was saved.
screen.worldarchive.notice.exit_cancelle: Backup cancelled. Your world was saved.
screen.worldarchive.notice.save_missing: The game closed before it saved the world, so no backup was made.
screen.worldarchive.notice.exit_interrup: Minecraft closed before the world exit backup finished, so no backup was made.
screen.worldarchive.notice.work_interrup: Minecraft closed before WorldArchive finished its work. Check your backups.
screen.worldarchive.notice.scheduled_war: Scheduled backup made, but a destination had a problem
screen.worldarchive.notice.scheduled_fai: Scheduled backup failed. Open Backups to see why.
